input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusive dealing on us: we may not participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI takes the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site. The restriction runs for the full term, which auto-renews annually under Section 4.1, so it exceeds the 12-month fallback ceiling, and there is no automatic exit for HDI's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates (Section 1.6 gives only a one-off launch-delay termination right, and terminating otherwise triggers the Section 4.2 Termination Payment). The narrow Section 6.2 closeout-merchandise carve-out does not cure this. That is walk-away territory (full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit), so we have taken the preferred position and replaced 6.1 with a non-exclusivity statement, leaving HDI's own restrictions in 6.3, which benefit us, untouched.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Replace Section 6.1 exclusivity with a non-exclusive provider statement; no sole-provider obligation on the Company.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Section 6.1, which barred us from any similar internet project for Deerskin or similar products for the whole (auto-renewing) term and gave HDI the exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand, with a non-exclusivity statement. Our position is no exclusivity or sole-provider obligation on us; if HDI needs something here, we could consider exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products for a single 12-month period ending automatically on any service level or delivery date failure.
